name: app-white-crypto-wallet-ui-kit-tilted-screen-field
title: Tilted Crypto Wallet UI Kit Field
whatItIs: A field of white wallet screens all rotated at the same angle over grey: sign in, home with balance and sparkline cards, token list, share and copy address, settings list with a blue Log Out button and a card grid for my wallet in yellow, green and blue, with Figma, XD and Sketch badges.
whatItMeans: Tilting the entire grid makes a kit feel dynamic, and small tint colours give each coin a card identity.
techniques: Whole screen grid rotated at one angle
White screens on light grey with soft shadows
Blue as the single action colour
Tool badges to state file formats

vocabulary.definition: A whole layout of screens turned by the same angle.
An icon showing which design tools a kit supports.
A card given a pale colour to identify its content.
